name: atiya-studio
description: Atiya Studio: edit mode in its own window, and a site of your own in three choices.

scripts.test: node scripts/sync-ui.mjs && cd ../.. && npx vitest run --config apps/desktop/vitest.config.mjs
scripts.e2e: node scripts/sync-ui.mjs && cd ../.. && npx playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/sync-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --before && electron-builder --win --publish never && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
